abstract: For any k at least 3, connected finite Ferrers graphs are equivalent for counting-free k-variable first-order logic of arbitrary quantifier depth precisely when their canonical twin-block staircase parameters coincide after truncation at k, up to side exchange. There are (k^(2m)+k^m)/2 theories at m levels.
integrity_note: An explicit universal mathematical proof is given; two independently executable standard-library programs provide finite corroboration, not an infinite certificate. No claim of independent validation.
limitations: Connected finite bipartite chain graphs with at least one edge only; no isolates or disconnected unions.
Counting-free, pure undirected adjacency signature; no named bipartition, no counting quantifiers.
No claim for variable widths one or two.
Absolute historical priority is not proven; independent mathematical audit is outstanding.
title: Sharp unrestricted finite-variable classification of connected Ferrers graphs
